pr_body: Refines the ADR 0121 prefab parity implementation after Windows Clippy identified an over-wide shared service signature. Prefab instantiation metadata is now grouped in a shared PrefabInstantiationRequest consumed consistently by Editor, CLI, and MCP, rather than suppressing the lint. The existing prefab creation/loading, fresh AssetId manifest registration, preview/apply stale guards, and one-transaction undo semantics remain unchanged.
